name: player_memory_e2e_h140
description: Balanced general gate: 8-session chats (2026-01..09) with a 王者荣耀 player whose life, ranks and people change over time, while the assistant makes 2-3 concrete promises in different sessions with varied wording (帮你盯着 / 我提醒你 / 陪你看看 / 帮你找 / 帮你列 / 我记下了). Per player 16 questions: 4 facts about the player, 2 facts about other people, 2 updates (现在...; stale_any = old values), 2 trajectories (ordered answer_all: one rank history incl. drops, and main heroes / phones / a relative's job or city; states in different sessions, some stated indirectly), 2 assistant promises (answer_any = a keyword stated only in an assistant line), and 4 negatives (a promise never made, a near-miss person whose attribute is never stated while another person's is, a person never mentioned, a topic never mentioned). dev=v10_d1,v10_d2; test=v10_t1..v10_t8, written blind to the system under test. + 140 neutral filler sessions per player (haystack_v1.json)
